summary: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC filed a Form 6-K on 27 April 2026 to announce the pence sterling amount of its final dividend for 2025. The board previously declared a final dividend of 125.9 cents per share on 17 February 2026, and the sterling equivalent of 93.2 pence per share was set using an exchange rate of 1:US$1.3504. Payment is scheduled for 14 May 2026, subject to shareholder approval at the AGM on 7 May 2026. This is a routine dividend announcement with no special structural or strategic implications; it does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation.
